name: Dimensionality Reduction for Transfer Function Domain
aliases: Local Linear Embedding (LLE) for Dimension Reduction
Locally Linear Embedding (LLE) for Transfer Function Design
definition: Dimensionality reduction algorithms (PCA, Isomap, LLE) are used to reduce high-dimensional feature vectors to a low-dimensional (e.g., 3D) representation while preserving relative distances between points.
summary: Dimensionality reduction for transfer function domain maps high-dimensional voxel features to low dimensions using nonlinear algorithms like Isomap and LLE to preserve local structures for simplified transfer function design.
